description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the UserRoles class in the Goteo application, specifically testing role management, permissions, and persistence functionality for user roles.

classes.name: UserRolesTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing UserRoles management, role addition/removal, permission checks, persistence, and relational permissions within the Goteo project.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiating the UserRoles object and confirms it is an instance of UserRoles and ArrayObject.

methods.name: testGetRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving roles for a user.

methods.name: testDefaultRoles
methods.description: Checks default role and permission assignments for the user.

methods.name: testAddRoles
methods.description: Tests adding a new role and handling of role addition exceptions.

methods.name: testRoleNames
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of role names as an array and presence of specific roles.

methods.name: testRemoveRoles
methods.description: Tests removing roles and handling of removal exceptions.

methods.name: testPersistence
methods.description: Checks saving roles to persistence and error reporting.

methods.name: testCheckPersistence
methods.description: Ensures role persistence reflects correctly when reloading roles.

methods.name: testRelationalPermsTranslator
methods.description: Tests assigning relational permissions for translation roles.

methods.name: testRelationalPermsReview
methods.description: Tests review-specific permissions with relational roles.

methods.name: testRelationalPermsCall
methods.description: Tests permissions related to call management.

methods.name: testRelationalPermsProject
methods.description: Tests project-related permissions and their assignment to roles.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up database entries created during tests.
